The '''44th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in film and television for 1986, were held on January 31, 1987 at the [[The Beverly Hilton|Beverly Hilton]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Friendly|first1=David|last2=Voland|first2=John|title=Winner Of 3 Top Trophies : 'Platoon' In A Victory March At Globe Awards|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1987-02-02-ca-69-story.html|access-date=17 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=2 February 1987}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title='Platoon' wins 2 awards at Golden Globe ceremony|url=https://www.nytimes.com/1987/02/02/movies/platoon-wins-2-awards-at-golden-globe-ceremony.html|access-date=17 January 2018|work=The New York Times|date=2 February 1987}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Anthony Quinn to be DeMille Honoree at the Golden Globes|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1987-01-10-ca-3371-story.html|access-date=17 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=10 January 1987}}</ref>
